notes.text: HAS ANYONE DONE THIS BEFORE? (orange speech bubble)
TWICE! HERE ARE THEIR NAMES AND PROJECTS (yellow speech bubble)
THIS WAY OUT! (robot with lantern by the ladder)
LIMBO: Virtuous but never found: published, citable, unread (DOI!, 5 VIEWS)
LUST: Seduced by every new portal (OOH ANOTHER REGISTRY!)
GLUTTONY: Endless rolling minutes, never digested (MINUTES HELP! 2019-2026)
GREED: Knowledge locked in senior heads, gone when they step down (IT'S ALL UP HERE!, HOW WE DID IT)
WRATH: The reply all storm. Just CC everyone, engage no one (OH NO! ANOTHER BIG EMAIL THREAD)
HERESY: Those who dared to automate
ANGER: Against links: moved folders, revoked access (PLANS 23, MINUTES, 403, OOPS)
FRAUD: The spreadsheet claiming to be current (WHO DOES WHAT (FINAL), I'M TOTALLY UP TO DATE!)
MY CUSTOM VIEW (browser window with chatbot saying HELLO! and a chart from 2015 to 2026)
